purpose: silver_ourairports_runways is the cleaned, one-row-per-runway view of bronze.ourairports_runways (10760 rows), typed and renamed for analytics and for joins to the airports dimension via airport_ref or airport_ident. It feeds runway capability analysis (length, width, surface, lighting) and endpoint geometry lookups.
usage: Read one row per id; join to airports on airport_ref or airport_ident, both of which have distinct_count 7591 and are non-null. Boolean lighted and closed replace the 0/1 indicators, so filter closed = false deliberately when you want only active runways, and exclude length_ft_is_zero = true when length is used as a measure. Endpoint columns (le_*/he_*) are optional geometry and must be null-checked before use.
limitations: Roughly 22 to 28 percent of endpoint geometry is missing (le_latitude_deg null_rate 0.220911 through le_elevation_ft 0.276301) and displaced-threshold columns are almost entirely empty (le_displaced_threshold_ft 0.884201, he_displaced_threshold_ft 0.899907); nothing is imputed. surface remains uncontrolled text with distinct_count 239, and le_ident/he_ident contain placeholder values such as '.' and '-'. Identifier columns stay VARCHAR despite numeric-looking samples, and heading columns keep the landed DECIMAL(38,9) scale. The id grain rests on distinct_count 10760 equalling row_count 10760 in this snapshot and must be confirmed against the warehouse.
